howToRead.title: How to Read Results
items: 'Top 10%' means you're in the top 10 out of 100 workers
Overall rank is based on all Korean wage earners (~21 million)
Age/gender/industry ranks show your position within that group
Median salary is the exact middle (50th percentile) value

dataExplain.title: About the Data
items: NTS wage income percentile data: year-end tax filers ranked by gross pay and split into 1% brackets (0.1% within the top 1%), with totals per bracket (used for the overall rank)
NTS publishes only bracket averages, so cut-offs, values in between and the distribution curve are interpolated estimates
Age/gender/industry ranks are estimated distributions built from published medians/averages
Data is for income year 2024 (filed in 2025, posted on data.go.kr in Feb 2026). Income year 2025 data is scheduled for Feb 2027

tips.title: Notes
items: Salary includes base pay + bonuses + allowances (excluding tax-free items)
Real purchasing power may differ from nominal salary due to inflation
Same salary feels different depending on region (Seoul vs. rural areas)

q1.question: What is the median salary in Korea?
q1.answer: Per the NTS wage income percentile data for income year 2024, the average gross pay of 21.08 million wage earners was about 44.75M KRW. The median estimated from the bracket averages is about 33.9M KRW; the average is pulled up by high earners, so the median is more representative.

q2.question: How much do I need to earn to be in the top 1%?
q2.answer: Estimated from NTS data for income year 2024, the top 1% starts at about 197M KRW in annual gross pay. Top 5% is about 116M KRW, and top 10% is about 89M KRW.

q3.question: How accurate is this data?
q3.answer: The overall rank uses the NTS wage income percentile (per-mille) data for income year 2024. NTS publishes only bracket averages, so cut-offs and values in between are interpolated estimates. Age/gender/industry ranks use estimated distributions and are for reference only. The raw data is on data.go.kr (NTS wage income percentile data).
